description: Synthetic sentences with gold PII spans. Every name, number and address is invented; the checksummed numbers are generated, not real. Kinds follow the placeholder: NAME, DATE, AGE (over 89), NHS NUMBER, SSN, ID, PHONE, EMAIL, URL, IP ADDRESS, POSTCODE, ZIP, ADDRESS, NUMBER, CARD. Sentences in the negatives group contain nothing to remove.
